_comment: License/entitlement config for the unified chat router. Since there's no login system yet, this represents a single 'current_user' profile — once real authentication exists, this becomes a per-client/per-user lookup instead of one fixed entry. 'false' means the router refuses to answer that category and returns a not-authorized message instead, without revealing which internal expert would have handled it. Per current instructions: this demo user is licensed for Implementation and Support only — BI Expert questions (stock/orders/navigation) are deliberately NOT authorized.
